reason: I already have a Claude project per client for about 20 a month, and it works in both Lithuanian and English. Coast is mostly the same chat with a calendar added, and it has no publishing, no approvals and no team seats, so it does not replace anything I use.
objection: Who is behind this? It looks like a side project. I would be moving 20+ client voices into it, and it might be gone in six months. A 2-day trial is also too short to test it on real clients, and I see nothing about how well it handles Lithuanian.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that it writes good Lithuanian, a real company behind it with a track record, and team seats plus client approvals actually shipped. A longer trial on my own clients would also help.
